MQTT_Broker.label: MQTT Broker
MQTT_Broker.description: This LwM2M Object provides the information to connect to an MQTT Broker i.e. URI, configuration, and keying material.

Client_Identifier.label: Client Identifier
Client_Identifier.description: MQTT Client Identifier to use when connecting to this MQTT broker.

Clean_Session.label: Clean Session
Clean_Session.description: The Clean Session value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Keep_Alive.label: Keep Alive
Keep_Alive.description: The Keep Alive value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

User_Name.label: User Name
User_Name.description: The User Name to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Password.label: Password
Password.description: The Password value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Security_Mode.label: Security Mode
Security_Mode.description:
Determines which security mode is used
                    0: PreShared Key mode
                    1: Raw Public Key mode
                    2: Certificate mode
                    3: NoSec mode
                    4: Certificate mode with EST

Public_Key_or_Identity.label: Public Key or Identity
Public_Key_or_Identity.description: Stores the Device’s certificate, public key (RPK mode) or PSK Identity (PSK mode).

MQTT_Broker_Public_Key.label: MQTT Broker Public Key
MQTT_Broker_Public_Key.description: Stores the MQTT Broker’s certificate, public key (RPK mode) or trust anchor. The Certificate Usage Resource determines the content of this resource.

Secret_Key.label: Secret Key
Secret_Key.description: Stores the secret key (PSK mode) or private key (RPK or certificate mode).

Certificate_Usage.label: Certificate Usage
Certificate_Usage.description:
The Certificate Usage Resource specifies the semantic of the certificate or raw public key stored in the "MQTT Broker Public Key" Resource, which is used to match the certificate presented in the TLS/DTLS handshake. The currently defined values are:
                    0: CA constraint
                    1: service certificate constraint
                    2: trust anchor assertion
                    3: domain-issued certificate

                    When this Resource is absent, value (3) for domain issued certificate mode is assumed.
